claim: Under Assumptions 1-3 and correct active-set identification, there exists an algorithm reaching a (delta, epsilon)-Goldstein stationary point in O~(delta^-1 epsilon^-3) oracle calls for linear and general convex lower constraints.

quantifiers.constraint_domain: linear or well-behaved general convex constraints

required_routes: released FFOLayer on an active nonlinear SOC family
independent first-hit calibration with multiple fixed horizons
